title: Irrational Local Maxima of the Fractional-Part Autocorrelation
strongest_result: Every irrational local maximum must be a stationary Wilton point, by a parity squeeze using Balazard–Martin equation (37). An explicit quadratic family and its reciprocals are excluded.
remaining_mathematical_gap: No stationary Wilton point with a strict local maximum has been constructed, and no universal exclusion of such points has been proved. The weighted Bernoulli-series residual in equation (11) has no established two-sided sign.
validation: Corrected outward decimal endpoint export by exact rational floor/ceiling, pinned to mpmath 1.3.0. Both 2048/40 and 4096/60 event-split interval runs regenerated. Original outputs preserved as historical nearest-rounded displays; in-memory sign tests unaffected. Release verification includes original byte-for-byte replays, corrected sign/nesting controls, 24 exact serializer tests, and the independent standard-library integer backend with 579 corner/root controls.
independent_review: Partial mathematics accepted; required endpoint-export correction applied separately. Corrected release awaits original reviewer binding.
correction: C1: directed endpoint export; no analytic proof, derivative sign, status, or budget change.
